works.author: Vitruvius
works.citation: ed. F. Krohn (Teubner 1912), cited by book, chapter and section
works.text_credit: Latin text CC BY-SA 4.0 (Perseus Digital Library, canonical-latinLit)
works.claim: A test of the First Drafts method on a Latin text, not a new translation: Vitruvius already has complete English translations. Scored against M. H. Morgan's 1914 translation, the two renderings agree with him on 64% and 66% of the key terms, about the same as the Galen drafts against their human reference (63.5% and 66.4%).
